Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/rolf-boldrewood/robbery-under-arms

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Rolf Boldrewood, the author, died 1915 (Wikidata Q2163271, P570 = 1915-03-11, 1915-01-01).

First publication of the text used: 1883 (SE colophon: 'Robbery Under Arms was published in 1883 by Rolf Boldrewood. Google sponsored the production of this ebook for Standard Ebooks. It was produced by David Grigg, and is based on a transcription produced in 1998 by Alan R. Light and David Widger for Project Gutenberg and on a transcription produced in 2021 by David Grigg for Standard Ebooks and on digital scans from the Internet Archive and at the National Library of Australia. The cover page is adapted from The Golden Splendour of the Bush, a painting completed in 1906 by William Lister Lister. The cover and title pages feature the League Spartan and Sorts Mill Goudy typefaces created in 2014 and 2009 by The League of Moveable Type. The first edition of this ebook was released on March 23, 2021, 5:35 p.m. You can check for updates to this ebook, view its revision history, or download it for different ereading systems at standardebooks.org/ebooks/rolf-boldrewood/robbery-under-arms. The volunteer-driven Standard Ebooks project relies on readers like you to submit typos, corrections, and other improvements. Anyone can contribute at standardebooks.org.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1883, before 1931;
  a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after
  publication, so this work entered it in 1978.
- Country of origin: every person named above died in 1915 or earlier, so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less, whatever its country of first publication.
